claim_scope: Read-only evidence manifest for refitting four existing TRELLIS/TRELLIS2 object assets to the original bedroom4 scene. It does not modify or promote a production world manifest.
global_limitations: The 25-frame source window is a narrow camera trajectory; the best per-object maximum view-ray baselines are only about 3.12 to 5.23 degrees.
No selected evidence observes a complete back, top, or bottom surface.
SAM3 masks are modal visible-region masks, not amodal object silhouettes.
This evidence is sufficient for source-camera placement and visible-proportion refit, not for claiming complete object geometry.

coverage.limitation: The source window provides a narrow camera arc only. Use these views to fit scene placement and visible proportions; do not claim back, top, or bottom geometry is observed.

selection_policy.mask_instance_association: same-category SAM3 candidates ranked by projected exact source-anchor point hit ratio
selection_policy.view_diversity: select maximum camera-to-object ray baseline pair, then the frame maximizing its minimum angle to that pair

camera_info.limitation: The upstream camera_info.json bytes are not present locally, so its recorded hash cannot be reverified in this audit. The byte-identical local/external cameras.json is the executable source-camera contract used here.

sam3_masks.warning: Per-frame file suffixes are detector output ordinals, not persistent object IDs. Every selected mask is associated through source-anchor projection.
